title: Account Groups
description: Groups are custom tags for assigning accounts to team members; each account belongs to at most one group.

empty.title: No groups yet
empty.description: Create a group and add accounts in bulk to organize assignments.

footnote: Status breakdown is computed from loaded accounts (first 200 if over 200 total); account counts always come from the backend.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete group "{{name}}"?
deleteConfirm.content: Accounts themselves will not be deleted; they will simply become ungrouped.

membersModal.title: Manage Group Accounts: {{name}}
membersModal.hint: Check to add to this group, uncheck to remove; only changes are submitted on save.
